pr_title: Fix ReferenceHandler test failures when enabling small buffer async in tests
pr_body:
Enables small buffer async in the ReferenceHandler test suite. Fixes a couple of bugs that were causing tests to fail:

* Fix `JsonPath()` methods throwing NullReferenceExceptions when `_count == 0 && _continuationCount == 1`.
* Temporarily address a corner case in the metadata reader async state machine implementation. To be addressed properly in an upcoming refactoring of the metadata reader components.

Fix #66727.
